note: Rights required to sell a MAREA product, compared with the rights actually evidenced. No provider contract, OEM agreement or redistribution licence exists. A public-domain or open-licence source is recorded as PERMITTED, but permission to use a dataset is not evidence that it is sufficient for the intended paid product.

rights.rightRequired: Commercial redistribution and offline caching of official electronic navigational charts for Spanish, Portuguese and adjacent cruising waters inside a paid navigation application
rights.notes: IHO S-57/S-63 distribution requires an OEM/data-server agreement and the national hydrographic offices (UKHO, Shom, IHM) publish no fee schedule and were not read. No agreement exists, so the right is NOT_GRANTED. This is the binding licensing blocker for MAREA NAV in its target geography.

rights.rightRequired: Use of a fee-free public chart/bathymetry source as a display or context layer
rights.notes: NOAA ENC is public domain but covers United States waters, not the MAREA target area; EMODnet bathymetry and OSM/ODbL data are context layers, not navigation-grade charts, and OSM tile usage policy forbids a heavy production tile load. Permission does not imply fitness for navigation, and no navigational guarantee may be made.

rights.rightRequired: Redistribution of a commercial third-party chart product inside the MAREA application
rights.notes: Garmin/Navionics offers an OEM/developer route but no published terms or price; C-MAP's EULA prohibits the use required; OSM tile policy prohibits heavy re-use. Any route needs a negotiated OEM contract, which is not authorised in MC-12.

rights.rightRequired: Commercial display and caching of marine forecast data in a paid consumer application, with the provider's attribution and forecast-validity rules
rights.notes: Copernicus Marine and DWD publish open licences with attribution conditions, but commercial re-display of a derived marine forecast product, SLA continuity and liability are not contractually confirmed. Meteomatics is quote-only and Stormglass terms were inaccessible. No executed data licence exists, so the right required for a paid WEATHER product is NOT_GRANTED.

rights.rightRequired: Use of a fee-free or metered weather source for an internal or low-volume prototype
rights.notes: A published self-serve plan (e.g. Stormglass EUR 49/month medium plan, Visual Crossing metered records) could support a prototype, but it is a published tariff, not a negotiated right, and does not settle redistribution or service continuity.

rights.rightRequired: NMEA 0183 standard licence and, where a NMEA 2000 interface is claimed, NMEA 2000 product certification
rights.notes: NMEA 0183 fee tiers are published (USD 1,150 manufacturer member / 7,500 / 10,000, USD 200 mnemonic) as a budgetary indication only; NMEA 2000 fee schedule and certification were not retrieved. NMEA2000_CERTIFIED = false. No licence, membership or certification is held.

rights.rightRequired: Machine-to-machine data plan with EU roaming, eSIM/SIM provisioning and a documented fair-use limit for WATCH telemetry
rights.notes: No operator contract, reseller agreement, SIM/eSIM supply agreement or activation exists. Published IoT tariffs are observations only. Terrestrial coverage offshore is not assumed.

rights.rightRequired: EU-region hosting agreement with a data-processing agreement covering vessel telemetry and personal data
rights.notes: No cloud account agreement, DPA or data-residency decision is executed. Published on-demand tariffs are observations only.

rights.rightRequired: Production map-tile serving for the application basemap
rights.notes: The OpenStreetMap Foundation tile usage policy prohibits heavy production use; a commercial tile provider or self-hosted tile stack is required, with its own cost and attribution obligations. No tile agreement exists.

rights.rightRequired: Clearance of the source code and third-party components incorporated into the products (inherited MC-02 state)
rights.notes: Inherited: SOURCE_IP_CLEARANCE = NOT_CLEARED. MC-12 does not clear it and may not assume a licence income stream from it.

rights.rightRequired: Legal clearance and registration of the MAREA mark
rights.notes: Inherited: TRADEMARK_LEGAL_CLEARANCE = NOT_GRANTED. MAREA is a proposed brand; no brand-derived pricing, licensing revenue or 'registered' claim may be modelled.
